title: Kandal police-headquarters protest seeking release of arrested relatives
reason: Reported group of Nhep Srun and ten others numbered 11, below the 50-person threshold.
notes: CamboJA describes this as a separate follow-on protest outside Kandal police headquarters demanding release of family members detained after the village land-dispute action. The article does not give this smaller protest’s exact date; no date is assigned.

title: Detained activists shave their heads in custody to demand justice and freedom
reason: The article describes several detained activists shaving their heads in custody, not a qualifying public gathering or meeting.
notes: This is a separate action mentioned by RFA in a section after the community gatherings. The article does not give an exact number, and the action occurred while participants were detained; do not merge it with the land-community assemblies.
